bothSidesReview.eligibility: On-record opposing positions from named members on both the procedural fight (the Luna-led bloc and Democratic leadership v. House leadership) and the underlying bill (Ranking Member Smith's cost objection), each anchored to recorded floor votes (Rolls 231, 254, 277, 278). Not false balance.
bothSidesReview.verbSymmetry: pass -- said/argued/called/warned/urged/described across both sides; none of notes/points out/claims/alleges/acknowledges/admits. Enforced by scripts/tracker-gate.js.
bothSidesReview.stripTest: pass -- every argumentative sentence names its holder (Rogers / Johnson / Luna / Turner-Miller-Spartz / Roy / Jeffries / McGovern / Smith) and resolves to a stored source; unsourced glosses and framings found in audit were removed (see fixed rows).
bothSidesReview.vehicleBill: HUMAN-verified 2026-08-27 (Fable, in-conversation): the passage vote (Roll 278) was ON H.R. 8800 itself per the stored action record. H.Res. 1438 Sec. 11 (stored rule text) directs the Clerk to append the House-passed text of S. 1383 -- the February SAVE America vehicle (Roll 69 record stored) -- in engrossment, so the engrossed bill transmitted to the Senate carries the election measure. NOTE: this intersects the save-america-act tracker, whose S. 1383 status section predates this development -- queue it for its own refresh.
bothSidesReview.staleness: The HR-8800 stage advance (Passed House 2026-07-22) is the SUBJECT of this refresh; dateModified is stamped by publish-article --refresh at publish time.

supporterLens.record: Independent supporter-lens: pass 1 NO (MIRV term misattributed to "observers"; missing in-the-moment Rogers case to the Rules Committee) -> fixes applied -> pass 2 NO (Smith's $1.6T attack unrebutted) -> fix applied -> final confirmation YES with byte-for-byte quote verification.

opponentLens.record: Independent opponent-lens: pass 1 NO (5 findings incl. blocking omission of Smith's substantive cost objection; GOP defections collapsed to one motive; unsourced "by custom" clause; McGovern role omitted) -> fixes applied -> pass 2 YES (all five confirmed resolved; two non-blocking depth suggestions, also applied).

resolution: First refresh of a frozen 2026-07-17 tracker, taken through the full Phase-5/6 audit lane. Core update: article was frozen at the June 30 rule failure; the bill passed the House 216-212 (Roll 278) on July 22 under a second rule (H.Res. 1438, adopted 214-211) whose Sec. 11 carries the SAVE America text into engrossment -- title, status, timeline, and both-sides resolution all rewritten from 15 fetched-and-stored sources. 22 findings fixed, including 7 defects inherited from the July version (two quote-boundary misquotes, the MIRV misattribution, an unsourced "900 amendments" and "$150B amendment" pair removed per Sec 6.4, an unsourced party attribution, and an unsourced bipartisanship characterization). Convergence: hostile pass 1 (zero fabrications, 1 attribution flag) -> fixes -> hostile pass 2 (4 findings) -> fixes -> final cross-model verification CLEAN with both lens sign-offs YES.
